entry.title: New: Bill 77 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, DEPARTMENT OF PLANNING, GRANT TO UNIVERSITY OF HAWAIʻI MAUI COLLEGE SEA GRANT" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget by decreasing the appropriation under Department of Planning, General - Category B by $12,695 and increasing the appropriation for the Grant to University of Hawaiʻi Maui College Sea Grant by the same amount.
